# XRPL Lending Protocol Hackathon

**September 12–13, 2026 · IIM, Campus du Parc, 47 Bd de Pesaro, Nanterre (Paris–La Défense)**

Hosted by DeVinci Blockchain and Ripple

RSVP: https://lu.ma/t4ttb973

WIFI :
Username: ZQ93FF77
Password: [redacted:env]

**HOOK INVITE CODE: BFT-PARIS-26**

https://github.com/RippleDevRel/xrpl-devex-hook/tree/main

## What you are here to do

Build a working experiment on the XRPL Lending Protocol:

- **XLS-65 Single Asset Vaults** hold pooled lender capital.
- **XLS-66 Lending Protocol** supports loan brokers, origination, drawdowns, repayment, impairment and default.

The goal is not a finished startup. Build a credible lending flow, exercise the tooling, and report the friction you encounter. A rough prototype with specific, reproducible feedback is more valuable than a polished demo with a thin write-up.

Teams have **2–4 people**. Choose **one of the two tracks** below.

## Event schedule

Campus is open from **08:00 to 21:00** both days. Saturday night is remote, with support on Discord.

### Saturday, September 12

| Time | Session | Who |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 09:00 | Doors, registration and breakfast | DVB |
| 09:45 | Welcome and introduction | Ripple / Maxime |
| 10:05 | XRPL workshop | Maxime |
| 10:25 | Lending Protocol workshop | Shota |
| 10:45 | Challenge, deliverables, feedback, prizes and judging | Ripple |
| 11:05 | Logistics and team formation | DVB |
| 11:30 | Hacking begins | All teams |
| 13:00 | Lunch |  |

| 20:00 | One-minute team stand-up | DVB and Ripple |
| 21:00 | Campus closes; continue remotely |  |

### Sunday, September 13

| --- | --- | --- |

| 11:00 | Drop-in pitch coaching | DVB |

| 16:00 | Awards and closing | Ripple and DVB |
